designer-initial.summary: Selected and audited a narrow five-usage threat-response system with 13 interactions, 12 complete cases, five scenarios, one principal response owner, and no mining/service mission governor.
questions_for_model: Can the supported GUMBO subset express the principal coordinator's two initialized state items and explicit eight-case next-state relation without relying on textual first-match semantics?
Can concrete containment preserve exactly 13 traced end-to-end semantic interactions when routing requires additional generated-support hops?

Can the report composer express one structured report and four acknowledgment/disposition priority cases while leaving response disposition and both commands exclusively owned by the principal coordinator?

diversity.selected_primary_scope: threat evidence, reporting, defense activation, and retreat-oriented navigation, with mining, cargo, docking, offload, resupply, and whole-mission governance external
diversity.closest_baseline: accepted replicate-1 Small combined mining-threat-retreat supervisor
diversity.why_not_extension_or_rename: The selected system removes cargo, capacitor, mining, service progress, mission phase, and five-way action arbitration; derives three threat-response facts through distinct owners; branches reporting after the sole response coordinator; and recovers through route availability, retreat completion, and request rearming rather than docking, offload, resupply, and return-to-idle progression.

model-review.summary: Clarify PART-02's omitted fourth valid defense/drone tuple; retain ALT-01 and all selected counts and behavior.

findings.evidence: MON-03 has four value pairs when both statuses are valid. CONS-03 assigns Available plus Ready to Ready but says Unavailable covers only 'both remaining valid combinations'; three valid value pairs remain. This leaves one tuple textually unassigned despite CONTRACT-LOCAL-02's required total 16-combination relation and makes exact bounded conformance ambiguous.
findings.requested_change: Change CONS-03 to assign Unavailable to all three remaining valid value combinations, and restate CONTRACT-LOCAL-02 as Ready exactly when both statuses are Valid, defense is Available, and drones are Ready. Change no PART, INT, metric, CASE, SCN, priority, recovery, state, or claim-boundary choice; preserve the intended Unknown/Ready/Unavailable behavior.

findings.evidence: After the localized tuple clarification, extensional audit shows PART-01 maps 16 evidence combinations to four threat classes, PART-02 maps 16 defense/drone combinations to three readiness classes, PART-03 maps 32 navigation combinations to four retreat classes, PART-04 makes state-dependent command and disposition choices, and PART-05 maps acknowledgment plus six dispositions to four priorities. None of these owner credits depends on a one-to-one rename or identity relation.

SysML-AADL library commit 9016cbcceefa92f0068e1811923704dd261d15f1 and Sireum v4.20260630.386eac9f support System/Process/Thread containment, typed DataPort connections, local GUMBO state and initialization, explicit compute cases, flat Data attributes, and multiple local state variables. One generated-support Process can place all five semantic Threads at depth 2 without acquiring behavior.

CASE-01 through CASE-08 are disjoint and exhaustive after explicit earlier-branch exclusions, and CASE-09 through CASE-12 cover both acknowledgment statuses, both acknowledgment values when valid, and all six dispositions. The boundary arithmetic yields exactly 196,608 input combinations and 1,179,648 input/pre-state snapshots.

The current harness validates ownership-audit wire fields and agreement between metrics and executed analyzer evidence but does not infer substantive ownership from role labels. Generation must therefore retain owner-local relation execution and witnesses, use values through INT-06 through INT-08 and INT-11, and leave copied response/report fields and routing hops uncredited.

designer-resolution.summary: Corrected PART-02's valid-tuple cardinality wording; retained ALT-01, exact metrics, policy, and claim boundary; Model generation authorized.

model-generation.summary: Canonical revision-2 ALT-01 model passes both retained Sireum gates, exhaustive bounded analysis, scenario evidence, ownership audit, and exact trace association review.

visualization.summary: Localized CTX-01 through CTX-04 presentation repair passes validated native review, exact trace audit, and zero-crossing/zero-route-collision gates without changing SysML semantics.

designer-final.summary: Revision-2 ALT-01 passes source, bounded semantic, ownership, traceability, and rendered-artifact fitness without silent drift; execution is not required by the seed.
